audit_mode: Read-only completed saved campaign, independently reconstructed frame/feedback/nominal+strict gates; no model/simulator calls
critical_boundaries: Midpoint gate PASS is limited to the unchanged nominal task-success definition on these seen cases; strict reliability regresses on sequence-mixed-16m node1.
The same first8m drift .372292m is below nominal .56m but above retained strict .28m; strict outcome must not be hidden or used to rewrite this gate.
16m midpoint retains about1.1116m global lateral and1.2091m endpoint error; it does not establish route-level accuracy restoration.
12m near-zero final lateral error coexists with about.7185m endpoint error; lateral alignment is not endpoint precision.
Binary nominal preservation coexists with increased local walking drift/heading and nonuniform continuous tradeoffs.
Fixed alpha0.5 is not proven optimal, universally superior or robust on independent data; repeats are deterministic identity checks.
All gains here are residual-off deterministic controller-reference effects, not learning gains.

future_same_frame_PPO_controls.arms: For each declared frame alpha0 and alpha0.5, retain its residual-off baseline and compare learned residual only against that same-frame baseline. A pooled learned-midpoint versus deterministic-actual comparison confounds frame with learning.
future_same_frame_PPO_controls.data: Current26cases are seen mechanisms; new learning/generalization evidence needs independently frozen train/evaluation separation.
future_same_frame_PPO_controls.fixed: Keep historical reward, observation, network, residual bounds/window, PPO budget and seed procedure frozen when testing the frame effect; retain old negative pilot and all current diagnostics.
future_same_frame_PPO_controls.metrics: Preserve nominal task, physical, primitive, strict losses, global lateral/heading/endpoint, translation geometry, time/stability and per-attempt evidence separately. Any later strict requirement needs its own prospectively declared criterion, never a retrospective change here.
future_same_frame_PPO_controls.risk: The retained local-heading reward may encourage a residual to undo the deterministic partial-ideal reference benefit; this remains a testable objective-alignment risk, not evidence to alter reward now.
future_same_frame_PPO_controls.status: Candidate future hypothesis only; no training authorized or performed by this audit

gate_components.strict_is_not_a_hard_gate: Strict regression is preserved and reported; not retroactively inserted into the inherited criterion.

geometry_scope: At the specific first 8m actual-frame progress threshold, not a guaranteed dynamic outcome or whole-route feasibility/optimality theorem. Midpoint rotates both control-frame axes; gain values and local measurement axes stay fixed.

actual_node_start.scope: Aggregate derived from existing retained node strict gates; not a new hard task score or hypothesis criterion.
